# eetree-sim 1
# name voltage-multiplier-cw2
# param VP 14.14
# param f 50
# param C 0.0001
# param RL 10000
# let dt = 1/(f*400)
# let sp = 40
$ 1 ${dt} ${sp} 50 ${VP*2} 50
v 64 192 64 128 0 1 ${f} ${VP} 0 0 0.5
c 104 96 152 96 0 ${C} 0 0
d 192 184 192 136 1 0.805904783
d 288 136 288 184 1 0.805904783
d 384 184 384 136 1 0.805904783
d 480 136 480 184 1 0.805904783
c 216 224 264 224 0 ${C} 0 0
c 312 96 360 96 0 ${C} 0 0
c 408 224 456 224 0 ${C} 0 0
r 544 264 544 312 0 ${RL}
g 544 312 544 328 0 0
g 64 256 64 272 0 0
207 608 224 640 224 0 VOUT
w 64 128 64 96 0
w 64 192 64 224 0
w 64 96 104 96 0
w 152 96 192 96 0
w 64 224 192 224 0
w 192 96 192 136 0

w 544 224 544 264 0
w 544 224 608 224 0
w 64 224 64 256 0
x 64 56 264 60 0 18 Cockcroft-Walton 2 级倍压（4 倍）
x 64 368 264 372 0 14 电容按计算器中的 C 取相同值；V1 峰值 ${si(VP)}V、${si(f)}Hz，负载 RL ＝ ${si(RL)}Ω
o 0 2 0 4098 ${VP*4} 0.01 0 2 12 0
o 12 64 0 4098 ${VP*4} 0.01 1 1
